_meta.description: Real Figma Webhooks V2 delivery (FILE_VERSION_UPDATE). The body echoes the shared `passcode` (set at webhook creation; the receiver constant-time-compares it — there is NO HMAC header), carries the Figma-assigned `webhook_id` (the install scope — Figma's POST /v2/webhooks returns it; the delivery body does NOT carry team_id), a `timestamp`, and the event fields (file_key, file_name, triggered_by). There is NO stable per-event id, so the handler discriminates by (file_key, timestamp). Doc-derived; passcode/ids are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://www.figma.com/developers/api#webhooks_v2 (passcode-in-body verification, no HMAC header; payload carries event_type/passcode/webhook_id/timestamp/file_key/file_name/triggered_by; no team_id and no event id in the delivery)

body.passcode: <the shared passcode set at POST /v2/webhooks; the contract test substitutes the active secret>
